_comment: The behavioural suite. Each scenario names an INVARIANT the system promises, not a feature it has. A scenario that fails means a safety or correctness property no longer holds, which is why the gate blocks on a regression. Add a scenario whenever a real failure is found: an incident becomes a case.

loop-termination.invariant: every generated loop terminates at a reachable human gate
loop-termination.why: An unbounded loop is a run that never finishes; an unreachable gate is a run that cannot stop.

constraint-survival.invariant: a NEVER/MUST NOT rule survives compaction, rotation and re-pinning into the primacy zone
constraint-survival.why: This is how 'NEVER store passwords in plaintext' silently becomes 'use secure auth', after which the model picks MD5.

rotation-refuses-when-impossible.invariant: an irreducible overflow is refused with the fix named, not looped on
rotation-refuses-when-impossible.why: A fresh session would overflow identically, so rotating would spin forever while appearing to make progress.

reviewer-independence.invariant: a reviewer is never the producer of the artifact it judges
reviewer-independence.why: A verifier that is the producer inherits its own blind spots and agrees for the same wrong reason.

gate-integrity.invariant: no node advances on an unevidenced done or an unrecorded irreversible decision
gate-integrity.why: Premature completion is the single most expensive failure in agent workflows.

delegation-safety.invariant: the delegation invariants S1-S5 refuse their violations and S4/S6 hold
delegation-safety.why: Delegation without these compounds error 15-20% per hop and can spend without bound.

autonomy-floor.invariant: no single setting can silently disable every human gate
autonomy-floor.why: The floor is what stops the loop guards and escalation design from becoming decoration.

router-asks-when-unsure.invariant: a gated or low-confidence route proposes ranked candidates rather than acting
router-asks-when-unsure.why: The router being confident is exactly when an unchecked choice is least justified.

health-evidence-over-noise.invariant: a new hire is not judged on one task, and a hard trigger overrides a healthy average
health-evidence-over-noise.why: Noise-driven quarantine punishes a hire for being new; an average hides a security trip.

ledger-override-is-explicit.invariant: an override carries a SUPERSEDED marker, and an irreversible decision is not re-made
ledger-override-is-explicit.why: Two contradictory decisions with no marker means a later agent may re-adopt the wrong one.

context-thresholds.invariant: the compaction ladder acts differently in each band and evicts only when warranted
context-thresholds.why: Reacting at 95% means the agent already spent fifteen turns with diluted attention.

planner-reports-gaps.invariant: a plan needing an unstaffed capability reports the gap before a run
planner-reports-gaps.why: Otherwise a graph runs three nodes and stops, far from the cause.

skill-enforceability.invariant: every library skill yields completion criteria, so no node can be ungated
skill-enforceability.why: A skill that parses as empty looks like coverage and is not.

memory-poisoning-guard.invariant: recalled memory is labelled context-only and never presented as a directive
memory-poisoning-guard.why: One bad run obeyed as an instruction becomes an invisible standing directive.

diagnostics-refuses-secrets.invariant: a diagnostics bundle refuses to carry a credential
diagnostics-refuses-secrets.why: A bundle is meant to be shared, so it must be safe by construction rather than by review.

idempotent-effects.invariant: a retried effect is not applied twice, while a deliberate rework is
idempotent-effects.why: Retries are guaranteed, so without this a crash-resume double-spends and duplicates work.

plan-validates-on-disk.invariant: a plan that validates in memory is readable by the library's own validator
plan-validates-on-disk.why: The runner reads the manifest from disk, so an in-memory-only valid plan is unusable.
